actual.coordinate_convention: Source world: x forward, y lateral, z up; extrinsic xyz roll/pitch/yaw. No camera transform.

reference.coordinate_convention: Source world: x forward, y lateral, z up; extrinsic xyz roll/pitch/yaw. No camera transform.

time_aligned.method: Same elapsed physical time in common time range; no phase warping.

phase_progress_aligned.method: Same declared phase label and normalized within-phase progress. This is a diagnostic alignment, never an actual execution trace.

tracking_diagnostics.scope: Root reference tracking reported separately; not used by actual-amplitude acceptance.

marker.name: R11_45_top_head_shell_volume_centroid
marker.method: Fixed volume centroid of the original closed positively oriented upper head shell, transformed once by the source R/t into HOME. Not whole-head COM and not a changing world-space bounding box.

self_comparison_must_not_pass.scope: Actual world amplitudes only. Reference tracking quality, camera and retiming cannot substitute for these two gates. Stability, foot progress/slip, caps and CAD checks remain separate.

head_COM_is_additional_metric: evidence/r20_sway_diagnosis.json uses fixed main-head COM as supplementary physical mass motion. Formal visual target uses this shell point.
